info.description: Per-page head metadata overrides — falls back to the site-wide SEO defaults when left empty

edit.label: Title override
edit.description: Overrides the page title in <title>/Open Graph/Twitter. Leave empty to use the page's own title.

edit.label: Description override
edit.description: Overrides the site-wide default description for this page only.

edit.label: Share image override
edit.description: Overrides the site-wide default share image for this page only.

edit.label: Hide from search engines
edit.description: Excludes this page from search results and the sitemap. Off by default.
